summary: V26.q 4-feature testing. Backend 7/7 pytest passed (manual_text offers, contact_id filter on /appointments, reschedule linkage). Frontend: (1) Bills manual text + mic + save buttons present for luce/gas/telco, POST /company-offers 200 with manual_text -> offer 'Offerta luce (manuale)' appears in list with source=manual. (2) 7th 'Appuntamenti' tab renders with 'In programma' + 'Effettuati' lists; 'Nuovo' button navigates to /appointment/new?contactId=... correctly. (3) calc-fab present on tab-notes and tab-files, absent on tab-info and tab-appts. tab-bills has its own calc-fab (embedded inside BillsSection, pre-existing). (4) Reschedule modal code + testIDs present in /app/frontend/app/appointment/[id].tsx (rescheduleModal state, resched-datetime, resched-notes, resched-cancel, resched-confirm, resched-type-presence, resched-type-phone). Automated UI verification of the modal opening on Rinviato/Da ricontattare toggle could not be completed via Playwright on the RN Pressable (3-attempt loop-prevention triggered). Backend flow (POST new appt + PUT rescheduled_to on old) verified via pytest.

integration_issues.flow: Reschedule modal open on outcome tap (Rinviato/Followup)
integration_issues.issue: Could not verify via headless automation — clicking the outcome chip via text locator did not toggle selectedOutcomeIds nor open the modal after 'Segna come fatto' was applied. Backend and testIDs are correctly wired; the code path exists. Recommend E1 verify manually or self-test in browser: mark appt as Fatto -> tap 'Rinviato' -> modal 'Rinvia appuntamento' should appear.

action_items: E1: manually verify reschedule modal (Feature 4) opens when tapping 'Rinviato' or 'Da ricontattare' on a Fatto appointment. Code inspection confirms logic and testIDs are present.
Consider adding testID directly on each outcome Pressable (e.g. outcome-chip-{o.id}) to make the modal-open behavior more reliably testable.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CompanyOfferIn: /company-offers rejects when both pdf_base64 and manual_text are missing (400) — good.
BillsSection saveManualOffer client-side enforces min 20 chars with a notify('Testo troppo corto') — good UX; backend also downgrades to status=error if <20 chars.
ContactAppointmentsSection uses 'query' param on api() for /appointments?contact_id=... — matches backend Optional[str] filter.
